name: InterContinental Sapporo
positioning: City hotel in Chuo-ku, Sapporo, by Nakajima Park, with a heated pool looking over the park and nearby mountains
best_for: Travelers who want a calm Sapporo base beside Nakajima Park
Guests who value spacious rooms, a club lounge and morning wellness sessions

facts.text: The hotel is at Minami 10-jo Nishi 1-chome in Chuo-ku, Sapporo; the nearest public transport listed is Nakajima-Koen Station, by Nakajima Park.
The hotel has a heated pool overlooking Nakajima Park and nearby mountains.
The indoor heated pool is on the 9th floor.
The Serenity Suite measures 160 square meters.
The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 14th floor, with gourmet breakfasts, seasonal afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
SAWAKA is a contemporary kappo restaurant where dishes blending traditional Japanese techniques with modern creativity are prepared at a live chef's counter.
Norva serves a signature afternoon tea by day and becomes a bar at night, with original cocktails and mocktails made with Hokkaido ingredients.
Guests can relax on the summer terrace with river views.

highlights.text: The heated pool overlooks Nakajima Park and the nearby mountains.
Complimentary morning wellness sessions offer poolside yoga, Pilates and a floating sound bath in the indoor heated pool.
The Club InterContinental Lounge on the 14th floor serves gourmet breakfasts, seasonal afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
The Serenity Suite measures 160 square meters, and even standard rooms start from 42 square meters.
SAWAKA is a contemporary kappo restaurant with a live chef's counter.

considerations.text: New Chitose Airport is about 52.8 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban city-center setting may not appeal to travelers seeking a secluded or resort-style escape.
